boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Sacred Heart University
boards.description: Ten currently documented food destinations in Fairfield and nearby Bridgeport with late service; confirm hours before leaving.

cards.title: Bill's Crossroads Cafe
cards.subtitle: 12 Tunxis Hill Cut Off, Fairfield — to 1–2 AM
cards.notes: Use the café’s posted schedule before heading out: it lists 1 AM closes Monday–Friday and 2 AM closes Saturday and Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfield café with posted service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Bill's Crossroads Cafe lists hours of 11 AM–1 AM Monday–Friday and 11 AM–2 AM Saturday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Monday–Friday 11 AM–1 AM; Saturday–Sunday 11 AM–2 AM.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on Post Road
cards.subtitle: 1580 Post Road, Fairfield — until 1 AM
cards.notes: Check the location page for the day’s closing time, then use its ordering link for pickup or delivery options.
cards.short_summary: A chain pizza location with a direct current late-hours listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's Fairfield location page states that this 1580 Post Road restaurant is open until 1:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently says “Open Today Until 1:00 AM”; verify the live status before travel.

cards.title: McDonald's on Post Road
cards.subtitle: 536 Post Road, Fairfield — drive-thru 24 hours
cards.notes: Use the restaurant locator’s separate lobby and drive-thru schedules; the drive-thru is the documented overnight option.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfield drive-thru with posted 24-hour daily availability.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists its 536 Post Road Fairfield drive-thru as open 24 hours daily, while the lobby closes at midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows lobby hours through 12 AM daily and drive-thru hours of 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Fairfield Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1201 Kings Highway East, Fairfield — Friday–Saturday to midnight
cards.notes: Plan this for a Friday or Saturday pickup: the restaurant’s own location listing posts midnight closing on those two nights.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza destination with a documented midnight weekend window.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield Pizza lists its Fairfield location as open until 12 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Fairfield hours: Friday–Saturday 10 AM–12 AM; other days close earlier.

cards.title: D.P. Dough Fairfield
cards.subtitle: 222 Post Road, Fairfield — reported until 2–3 AM
cards.notes: Check the shop’s live ordering channels before leaving; local reporting identifies the Post Road address and late nightly schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfield calzone shop documented by local news as a late-night food option.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Post reported D.P. Dough's Fairfield shop closes at 2 AM most nights and 3 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Connecticut Post — D.P. Dough, Kevin's Corner give Fairfield's Post Road Plaza new life
cards.access_notes: Connecticut Post reports 2 AM closes most nights and 3 AM Friday–Saturday; confirm current service before travel.

cards.title: Panaro's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 2264 Fairfield Avenue, Bridgeport — Thursday–Saturday to midnight
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s posted Thursday-through-Saturday window for a late pickup or delivery order from its Fairfield Avenue location.
cards.short_summary: A Bridgeport pizzeria with official midnight hours on three nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Panaro's Pizzeria lists Thursday through Saturday business hours of 11 AM to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Thursday–Saturday 11 AM–midnight; Monday–Wednesday and Sunday close at 11 PM.

cards.title: Fire Engine Pizza Company
cards.subtitle: 2914 Fairfield Avenue, Bridgeport — late-night pizza to midnight
cards.notes: Order from the late-night pizza offering, whose posted schedule runs until midnight after the main menu has closed.
cards.short_summary: A named Bridgeport pizza stop with a separately posted late-night menu window.
cards.evidence_claim: Fire Engine Pizza Company posts late-night pizza service until 12 AM, with Friday and Saturday service beginning at 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists late-night pizza 10 PM–12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 11 PM–12 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Sergio's Pizza & Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 780 Madison Avenue, Bridgeport — Friday–Saturday to 2 AM
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own ordering page to check the day before making a late run; weekend hours extend to 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Bridgeport pizza restaurant with official 2 AM weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Sergio's Pizza & Restaurant lists hours until 2 AM on Friday and Saturday and until 1 AM Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday 11 AM–2 AM; Sunday–Thursday hours end at 1 AM.

cards.title: Don Raphael Brazilian/Portuguese Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 256 Oak Street, Bridgeport — Friday–Saturday to 2 AM
cards.notes: Consult the restaurant’s posted day-by-day schedule before setting out; Friday and Saturday have the latest listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Bridgeport restaurant with official service listed until 2 AM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Don Raphael lists 2 AM closing times on Friday and Saturday, with 1 AM closing times Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday 11 AM–2 AM and Sunday–Thursday service ending at 1 AM.

cards.title: Frankie's Diner
cards.subtitle: 1660 Barnum Avenue, Bridgeport — 24 hours Saturday and Sunday
cards.notes: Use the diner’s live weekly schedule to choose a late visit; Saturday and Sunday are listed as open around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A diner whose official schedule includes 24-hour weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: Frankie's Diner lists Saturday and Sunday as open 24 hours, with late weekday hours also posted.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Saturday and Sunday as open 24 hours; Monday–Thursday close after 1 AM and Friday at midnight.
